title: The Desperate Ask
setup: An older woman sits on the steps outside a bank, holding a paper. She explains that her son's hospital bill is ₹2400. She has ₹800. She needs the rest by this afternoon or the hospital won't release him. She has a phone with a number you can verify the story with. You have ₹600 on you — your transport money for the rest of the day.

personaContext.arjun_das: He sends money home every month to people in exactly this situation. But that's family. This is a stranger. He cannot verify anything. And if she's not telling the truth, he walks home.
personaContext.priya_mondal: She's heard this story before. Some real, some not. She also knows which charitable trusts sometimes help with medical bills.
personaContext.ramesh_paswan: He's been the person on those steps. He gave everything he could to people he barely knew when he first arrived because that's how the network works.
personaContext.siddharth_roy: He doesn't have ₹600 to spare right now, even though he appears to. The fiction requires looking like he does.
personaContext.nasreen_begum: She'd know which NGO can bridge this in 4 hours. She also has no cash herself today.

choices.text: Give her all ₹600. Walk home or borrow transport money.
choices.narrativeOutcome: She calls someone immediately. There's a relief in her face that is not performable. You walk 40 minutes home. You are tired and slightly light-headed. Something feels correct.

choices.text: Give ₹200. Keep enough to get home. Tell her to try a few more people.
choices.narrativeOutcome: She takes it without expression. Not gratitude, not disappointment. She has more calls to make. You keep ₹400. You wonder if ₹200 helped or just spread the problem thinner.

choices.text: Give no money but spend 15 minutes helping her find an emergency medical charity that can help.
choices.narrativeOutcome: You find one number that might work. She calls. Gets put on hold. You leave her there, phone pressed to her ear, waiting. You don't know what happens next.

choices.text: Tell her you can't help. You don't know if the story is true.
choices.narrativeOutcome: She nods. No argument. She already knew most people would say this. The city moves around her. You move with it.
